let first = null;
console.log(first);
first = String(1);
console.log(first.toUpperCase());
var second = undefined;
second = Number(2);
console.log(second.toFixed(1));
function capture() {
  let value = null;
  value = "done";
  return () => value.toUpperCase();
}
console.log(capture()());

type GlobalUndefined = typeof undefined;
const missing: GlobalUndefined = undefined;
{
  let undefined = 5;
  undefined++;
  console.log(undefined.toFixed(1));
}
function shadowedUndefined(undefined: number) {
  return undefined.toFixed(1);
}
console.log(shadowedUndefined(7), missing);
